name: GameVault
description: GameVault is an innovative gaming platform providing a self-hosted, source-available alternative to popular gaming platforms. It lets you and your friends enjoy DRM-free games stored on your file server in an organized way. This is the official Unraid Template supported by Phalcode. Please read the documentation on https://gamevau.lt.
